card.name: Rare names and non-English script pieces
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after proper names and foreign-script text, such as Chinese characters, Lao script, and names like Lilacs, Natchez, or New Advent. It fires on the name piece itself, not on common drug or dose words.

modes.label: Chinese characters
modes.description: A Chinese character inside a quoted Chinese passage or a Chinese author name.

modes.description: A later piece of a split proper name or place name in English text.
